description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git cherry-pick' functionality, specifically focusing on rerere and conflict resolution scenarios within a Git repository. It defines test cases that simulate various conflict and rerere auto-update configurations.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with the specified message and changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description and commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes commands expecting them to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or contents, likely to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or modifies configuration variables for testing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
